goal: Wire the browser preview singleton into dispatch.mjs: the cmux_preview_url config reader + validator, the <stateDir>/browser.json sidecar under withRecordLock with a bounded critical section and a pre-create authority scan (reuse/create/fail-closed — no adopt), the four-conjunct dispatch trigger, the dispatchCmd preview JSON key, and teardown deletion of browser artifacts. PR-1 tip: bump plugin to 0.1.63.
constraints: scripts/cmux/contract.mjs and scripts/cmux/cmuxctl.mjs must be byte-identical in this slice (cmuxctl was be-12-01's; consume its exports as-is). workspace.json gains NO key and workspaceCmd is UNTOUCHED in the diff.

The normative design is .claude/dev-team/tasks/issue-12/architecture-package-v2.md WITH the v2.1 errata (E1-E11) appended at its end — the errata WINS on contradiction. This slice implements §3 D4 (as amended by E1/E2/E3), D7, D8 (as amended by E6), §4 IC-1 and IC-5 (as amended by E6), and the E7 teardown glob.

The whole resolve→decide→create→verify→stamp runs inside withRecordLock(<stateDir>/browser.json path, ...) (record.mjs:834, already imported at dispatch.mjs:39; worktrees.json precedent at :485,:550). RecordLockError → catch → log preview_lock_contended → skip, code 0. THE LOCK SPANS THE SIDE EFFECT, NOT JUST THE WRITE.

Bounded critical section (errata E1): at most three bounded spawns — scan tree (tree({all:true, timeoutMs:3000}), doubling as treeBefore), browserOpen (5000, performs one own tree read at 3000 returned as treeAfter), nothing else — stated invariant comment at the lock site: worst case 11000ms, 19000ms margin under LOCK_STALE_MS (30000); any future spawn added inside must be bounded and the budget recomputed. Reuse and fail-closed paths cost one bounded tree.

Abandon executes OUTSIDE the lock (errata E2): both post-create checks (idempotence re-scan and pane check) are DECIDED inside the section on treeAfter; on either abandon verdict the section exits without stamping and the best-effort closeSurface of our own surface runs after lock release (the abandonOrphan shape — 'close attempted', never 'closed'), then the loud line (preview_double_create_detected / preview_landed_in_worker_pane), code 0.

The pre-create authority scan partitions browser-typed surfaces in the bound workspace using PARENT-SIDE STATE ONLY — no titles, no URLs: worker-pane browsers = in the pane holding workspace.json.initial_surface_id (located via the surface id, NEVER via initial_pane_id) OR in a pane id belonging to any dispatch record (listRecords, terminated included) whose surface.workspace_id equals the live bound workspace id and whose pane id resolves in the current tree; free browsers = everything else. Outcomes: recorded surface valid (present, browser-typed, workspace_id matches sidecar AND live binding) → reuse (zero creates, nothing re-stamped); no valid record and zero free → create+verify+stamp; no valid record and >=1 free → FAIL CLOSED, create nothing, adopt nothing (there is NO adopt outcome), reason preview_topology_unverifiable when any same-workspace record's pane id failed to resolve in the current tree, else preview_surface_ambiguous.

The fail-closed skip does not self-heal (errata E3) — the log line IS the recovery mechanism and uses the frozen shape: 'ensurePreviewBrowser: <N> browser surface(s) outside this workspace's worker panes and no valid preview record — refusing to create a second (two stacked browser surfaces are both undrivable). Preview is disabled for this task until they are closed: cmux close-surface <uuid>[ · cmux close-surface <uuid>…]'. preview_topology_unverifiable uses the same shape with its own leading clause naming the unresolvable record pane id.
ensurePreviewBrowser takes its OWN fresh tree — never dispatchCmd:921's liveTree (it predates this dispatch's createPane/mountDocTab surfaces).

Sidecar IC-1 shape: { surface_id, pane_id, workspace_id, origin, created_at } — all UUIDs lowercase, origin only (scheme://host[:port]), never the full URL. Written only by ensurePreviewBrowser under the lock; absent = no preview; malformed = absent + loud line (readJsonOrWarn, dispatch.mjs:265-273).

Trigger (four conjuncts, all required, evaluated in dispatchCmd between mountDocTab (:1100) and setPhase('building') (:1107), inside a try/catch that logs and continues — a preview failure NEVER fails a dispatch): (1) readCmuxPreviewUrl returns a URL; (2) spec?.domain === 'frontend' exact match; (3) resolved.isolation === 'worktree'; (4) 'browser.open' in the cached preflight methods (readPreflightCache(...) || {} mirroring teardownCmd:1953; absent/unreadable/malformed/missing-method → skip with ONE stderr remediation line naming 'brew upgrade --cask cmux, or re-run preflight').

dispatchCmd's stdout JSON gains preview: {state: 'reused'|'created'|'skipped', reason?: <enum>} with enum preview_lock_contended | preview_surface_ambiguous | preview_topology_unverifiable | preview_double_create_detected | preview_landed_in_worker_pane | preview_capability_missing. THE KEY IS OMITTED ENTIRELY unless conjuncts 1-3 are all true (errata E6 — preserves AC1 byte-identity; preview_disabled is NOT a dispatch-time member).

readCmuxPreviewUrl: ADR-018 reader shape verbatim beside readCmuxEnvFile (dispatch.mjs:119-167) — stripFencedCodeBlocks, one regex (PREVIEW_URL_LINE_RE), >1 line → OperationalError 'ambiguous (a fenced example?), refusing', absent/blank → null. Validator (throw before any spawn; refusals name the reason and the scheme, NEVER the value): .trim() first; refuse any '@'; full-match ^https?:\/\/[A-Za-z0-9.-]+(:\d{1,5})?(\/[A-Za-z0-9._~:\/?#\[\]!$&'()*+,;=%-]*)?$; port when present <= 65535 (explicit numeric check); refuse any '%' not followed by two hex digits; length <= 2048. Comment the two deliberate exclusions: backslash (WHATWG treats \\ as / in special schemes) and the case-sensitive https? anchor.

teardownCmd: BEFORE archiveOrDelete, delete <stateDir>/browser/ (recursive, force) and <stateDir>/browser.json* (glob is load-bearing: withRecordLock writes a sibling browser.json.lock a crash can strand — errata E7). The deletion is unconditional INCLUDING under --keep-artifacts (exposure beats post-mortem value).
A comment at dispatch.mjs:764 recording that this slice deliberately declined to give initial_pane_id a reader (exclusion is via initial_surface_id).

Test doctrine: new tests in test/cmux-dispatch.test.mjs (never a new file importing it); positives first; makeSpecFile(ctx, sliceId, {domain:'frontend'}) is the frontend fixture (default is backend, :111); grep before touching anything near the ~12 whole-workspace-state deepEqual sites (3459, 3492, 3500, 3584, 3762, 3777, 3790, 3873, 3887, 3940, 4110, 4142) — they stay green because workspace.json gains no key.
acceptance_criteria: A/B on the same fixture flipping only cmux_preview_url: key absent → zero browser invocations, no browser.json, deepEqual of written workspace.json vs pre-feature baseline, and NO preview key in the dispatch JSON; key set (frontend spec, worktree role, browser.open in cache) → exactly one browser open with exact argv incl. --focus false. Same no-preview-key assertion for a backend spec and for a non-worktree role with the key set.

Singleton outcomes each tested: 0 free → create+stamp (sidecar has lowercase UUIDs, origin only, created_at ISO-ms); recorded surface live → reuse, zero opens; recorded surface gone → create; workspace_id mismatch (sidecar vs live) → create; >=1 free browser + no record → zero opens, preview_surface_ambiguous, AND one stderr line matching the frozen remediation shape naming every stray surface UUID with an exact 'cmux close-surface <uuid>' per stray; a same-workspace record's pane id unresolvable in the live tree while a free browser exists → preview_topology_unverifiable with the unresolvable pane id named plus the same remediation assertion; a rung-2 doc-tab browser inside a worker pane neither blocks creation nor is adopted; a collapsed doc-tab pane (terminal closed, browser surface alone, record terminated) is excluded via its record's surface.pane_id; the initial pane is excluded via initial_surface_id and a reordered panes[] does not change the outcome; no reachable path leaves two browser surfaces in one pane.

Concurrency: pre-created lock file → zero opens, preview_lock_contended in the dispatch JSON, code 0; _simulateTreeHang inside the section → the bounded tree returns spawn_error and the section aborts well under 30s; after-tree showing a second free browser → abandon (no stamp, close attempted AFTER lock release, preview_double_create_detected, code 0); recovered pane in the worker-pane set → abandon with preview_landed_in_worker_pane. Mutations red (apply, observe, revert, report): remove the lock; narrow the lock to the write only; remove the idempotence check; remove any in-section timeoutMs; move the abandon close back inside the lock; drop the fresh-tree corroboration of the recorded surface_id (trust the sidecar alone); drop the workspace_id equality check.

Trigger conjuncts one at a time with the others held true: non-worktree role → zero browser calls; 'Frontend' and 'frontend ' → zero calls; preflight cache lacking browser.open / absent / unreadable / malformed → zero calls, code 0, exactly one stderr remediation line. Dropping the domain conjunct must fail a test.

URL validator: '@' refused; hostless forms (https://?, https://#, https://@) refused; port > 65535 refused; '%' without two hex digits refused; trailing \r trimmed; two cmux_preview_url lines → OperationalError with zero cmux invocations; file:// and javascript: refused before any spawn. Mutations red: unanchor the regex; swap the scheme allowlist for a denylist; make readCmuxPreviewUrl take-first on ambiguity.

Teardown: on BOTH branches (shouldArchive true and false), no file matching browser/** or browser.json* survives (including a stranded browser.json.lock); a --keep-artifacts run still removes all three; the preview surface id appears in the fake's close-surface invocation log.
Non-interactions pinned: closeCmd's doc-tab collapse decision unchanged with a live preview present; reconcile rows unchanged.

The lock-site invariant comment states the 11000ms worst case against LOCK_STALE_MS and a test asserts the sum (noting in a comment it is non-vacuous only in combination with the per-call hang tests).
